_comment: THE DEVICE-UNDER-TEST BINDING. All the benches instantiate the
subcircuits this file names -- a live, swappable pointer, not a fixed
record of one netlist. The 'active' entry is what a run with no --dut
flag binds; any entry in 'duts' is selectable by id via
run_corners.py --dut <id> (see sim/dut/README.md for the full contract).
Per-entry fields:
netlist     path relative to sim/, must satisfy the interface contract
in sim/dut/README.md (checked at load time by harness/dut.py;
an 'extracted' entry must satisfy the whole-comparator
subckt only -- a flat extraction has no analog/latch partition)
id          short identifier stamped into every record and deck header;
must equal the entry's key in 'duts'
provenance  placeholder | schematic | extracted -- 'placeholder' makes
every record it produces carry a banner saying the numbers
substantiate the harness and not a spec row; 'extracted' is
the post-layout binding (its records document the delta
against the latest schematic-provenance record of the same
bench, and their netlist is regenerated scratch -- see
layout/run_extract_sim.py, issue #23)
params      operating-point parameters the harness emits as .param, so
all benches bias the DUT identically without each
re-stating the numbers

comparator-dr0001.description: DR-0001 topology: a resistively-loaded NMOS differential preamplifier (comparator_dut_analog) feeding a StrongARM latch with isolation inverters and a NOR SR output latch (comparator_dut_latch). See spec/decision-records/DR-0001-comparator-topology.md for the sizing rationale and design/README.md for the xschem source and netlisting command.
notes: dut_ib is the tail-mirror reference current forced into the `ibias` pin.
dut_vcm is the input common mode the front end is specified at. It is a property of the DUT, not of any one testbench, so it lives here.

1.65 V is mid-rail (VDD/2 at the nominal 3.3 V supply) -- there is no CDAC or other driving circuit to inherit a common mode from here, so mid-rail is the natural standalone choice; DR-0001 states this explicitly.

comparator-dr0001-layout.description: Post-layout (extracted-netlist) binding of the same DR-0001 comparator: layout/comparator.gds extracted with `klt extract --parasitics` (first-order lumped RC per net plus vertical-overlap coupling), adapted onto the PDK's ngspice simulation primitives and the comparator_dut interface by layout/run_extract_sim.py. The extraction is LVS-matched to design/comparator.spice's comparator_dut per layout/lvs/comparator.lvs.json (issue #22); the device-class-to-primitive mapping is the same correspondence run_lvs.py's DEVICE_GEOMETRY_MAP asserts.
notes: The netlist is regenerated scratch (gitignored): run `python3 layout/run_extract_sim.py` before simulating against this entry (run_corners.py --dut comparator-dr0001-layout). The committed evidence for what it was extracted from is layout/lvs/comparator.extract-rc.json.
Params are identical to the schematic entry by design: the post-layout delta a record documents must be the layout parasitics' effect, not an operating-point change.

A flat extraction defines only the whole-comparator subckt -- the two analog-partition benches (comparator-offset-mc, comparator-preamp-noise) are refused against this entry with a message naming the schematic binding.

First-order lumped RC (one series R + one ground C per net, star-distributed across terminals, plus vertical-overlap coupling caps): no per-segment distributed RC ladders, no lateral coupling except on --critical-net nets (none named here). Per-net values are in the committed extract report.

comparator-dr0004-cascode-exp.description: EXPERIMENT, NOT RATIFIED: the DR-0001 comparator with the preamp input-pair cascode proposed by spec/decision-records/DR-0004-preamp-input-cascode-kickback.md (MCP/MCN nfet_03v3 L=0.5u W=20u, divider-biased vcas = 0.6*vdd via XRCT/XRCB, gate-cap decoupler XMCC). Its xschem source is design/proposed/dr0004-cascode/comparator_dut_analog.sch. Carried beside, not in, design/comparator.spice so the ratified netlist -- which the signoff LVS (item 4) and item-5 corner-matrix envelopes pin by sha256 -- is untouched until DR-0004 is ratified and the layout/LVS/PEX follow-up (#112) re-pins it.
notes: Select with `--dut comparator-dr0004-cascode-exp` (run_corners.py, sim/tools/klt_record.py, sim/tools/mk_klt_request.py). Never the 'active' entry.

sha256 79dcc79fb6a876bc46ab258af5eae3f2d24b3e41281df2c23d81897ddf34ed24: byte-identical to the design/comparator.spice the issue-#102 cascode records were minted against. Those records (committed before this binding existed) stamp dut id `comparator-dr0001` and path `design/comparator.spice` with this sha256; the sha256 is what ties them to this file -- see sim/dut/README.md.
Params are identical to the comparator-dr0001 entry by design: the experiment changes topology only.
